# Commands

Available in this context. Use `/man command` for examples, scopes and required permissions.

## General

- `/sudo /command [arguments]` — Run one command with superuser authority

- `/permissions [scope]` — Inspect effective grants

- `/help` — List commands available here; /man command explains usage

- `/man [command|topic]` — Read command and grant-system manuals

- `/whoami` — Show your name and global group label

## Account

### `/user`

List users, inspect or update metadata, and manage accounts

- `/user ls [scope]` — List accounts globally or members of a room
- `/user get who [key] [scope]` — Read one user's metadata, or use @all for the scope
- `/user set who key value [scope]` — Set scoped metadata; color uses ownership/room grants, other keys require su
- `/user rename [who] name` — Rename yourself or an authorized account
- `/user new name password [user|admin]` — Create an account; the default group is user
- `/user delete who` — Delete an account and its private conversations
- `/user disable who` — Disable an account, revoke sessions and room access, and transfer owned rooms to su
- `/user enable who` — Enable login without restoring previous room access or ownership
- `/user passwd old new` — Change your password and sign out other sessions
- `/user reset who key|@all [scope]` — Reset scoped metadata; color uses ownership/room grants, other keys require su; or reset a password
- `/user reset who password new-password` — Reset scoped metadata; color uses ownership/room grants, other keys require su; or reset a password

### `/grant`

Assign a group or add a scoped permission; /man grant explains

- `/grant user|@all group [#room|@global]` — Assign a predefined permission bundle
- `/grant user|@all scope permission` — Add a scoped action or command grant

### `/revoke`

Remove a group assignment or direct permission; /man revoke explains

- `/revoke user|@all group [#room|@global]` — Remove a predefined group assignment
- `/revoke user|@all scope permission` — Remove a direct scoped permission

## Rooms

### `/room`

List and manage rooms and membership

- `/room ls` — List rooms you can discover or read
- `/room new #name` — Create an invitation-only room
- `/room delete #name` — Delete a room and its messages
- `/room rename #name new-name` — Rename a room while preserving its identity and history
- `/room join #name` — Open an authorized room
- `/room leave [#name]` — Leave a room after transferring ownership if needed
- `/room add user [#room]` — Invite a user to a room
- `/room kick user [#room]` — Remove a user's room membership and scoped access
- `/room owner user [#room]` — Transfer room ownership

## Messages

- `/edit message-id message` — Edit a retained message; requires own/any-message permission

- `/retract message-id` — Delete any retained message by ID

## Server

### `/bot`

Manage bot accounts and credentials

- `/bot ls [#room|@global]` — List bot accounts in a scope
- `/bot new <bot name> [#room|@global]` — Create a bot account in the selected scope
- `/bot info <bot name> [#room|@global]` — Show bot ownership, status and permissions
- `/bot owner <bot name> <user name>` — Assign the bot owner
- `/bot rm <bot name> @global` — Delete a bot account and its credentials
- `/bot token new <bot name> <label>` — Issue an issuer-only bot token, shown once
- `/bot token ls <bot name>` — List issuer/worker credentials, scopes and expiry
- `/bot token rm <credential id>` — Revoke a credential
- `/bot token rm <bot name> <credential id>` — Revoke a credential

### `/system`

Inspect server configuration and lifetime metrics

- `/system configs` — Show active configuration in a Markdown JSON block
- `/system metrics [--txt]` — Show lifetime cache and pool counters; --txt returns a shareable text code block

- `/clean age scope [--dry-run]` — Delete or preview old messages in an explicit room or private scope
